_notes: Supports freeform surface brightness and free tilted rings (rotation_curve: rings).
Install: see docs/install-bbarolo.md. JSON does not allow // comments — use _keys for notes.
Copy this file, set dataset/out/spectral/priors, then: pyuvkin fit template_bbarolo.json
_image_centre_note: source offset [dRA, dDec] arcsec from the phase centre
_model_note: for a parametric curve use rotation_curve: arctan|tanh|exponential|isothermal and drop n_rings/free/twostage; set maximum_velocity + turnover_radius priors instead of vrot
_surface_brightness_note: freeform: morphology from uv-plane moment map (omit intensity/scale_radius priors). analytic: exponential disc — add those priors
_priors_note: one prior per base name broadcasts to every ring; override with vrot_3 etc.
_search_note: start=bbarolo|fitmod3d runs FitMod3D on the dirty cube then seeds uv-plane L-BFGS. Prefer nautilus/dynesty when many rings are free. rings defaults: eps=1, gtol=2.5e-3*n_rings
